Market today: The mood is mixed. While AI infrastructure build-out continues, driving demand for your chip names, rising AI safety concerns could introduce volatility. Easing Treasury yields are a positive for growth stocks, but inflation worries persist in the background.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.69%) and SPAL (-36.58%) are your main concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and are deep in the red. On margin, these drawdowns are amplified and need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yield movements, as they directly influence tech valuations. Also, monitor any new developments around AI infrastructure spending and regulatory discussions.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged, underperforming positions to protect capital, especially with margin.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL to reduce exposure to leveraged decay and significant losses. Their "SELL" status and deep drawdowns are a red flag on margin.
SMH is a holding with a scanner BUY signal (entry 599.41-598.81, stop 597.52). If you're looking to average down or add to chip exposure, this is a potential entry.
TSM shows an "ACCUMULATE" signal (entry 452.43-451.97, stop 451.13). This chip giant could be a new long idea, supported by ongoing AI infrastructure demand.
